get.description:
Companies ranked by open-market insider trading over the last `days` days.

What is counted, and why:

* Only **open-market purchases and sales** (Form 4/5 codes P and S). Awards,
  option exercises, tax withholding and gifts are left out of every column,
  because none of them is a decision to buy or sell at the market price.
* Only **current** rows. When an amendment (4/A) corrects a trade, the
  corrected row counts and the replaced one doesn't, so nothing counts twice.
* The window runs on the **trade date**, from `since` to today (US Eastern),
  both inclusive. A trade dated in the future (a typo in a filing) isn't in
  "the last N days", so it is left out.
* Dollar sums add the values reported on the filings. Two kinds of trade
  still count as trades but add nothing to the sums, so the sums are lower
  bounds when either count is above zero:
  - `trades_without_price`: the filing gives no price, so there is no value;
  - `trades_left_out` (per side `buys_left_out`, `sells_left_out`): the
    filing gives a price, but it isn't a dollar price per share: another
    currency (UMC's Form 4s state New Taiwan dollars), a foreign listing
    whose currency isn't stated (Bradesco's BBDC4), or a figure that can't
    be right as filed (smt/ingest/quality.py flags all three
    `value_implausible`). These did report a price, so calling them
    "no price" would be wrong.
  A side with no trades has a null sum (shown as a dash, never $0).
* `insiders` counts the owner each trade is attributed to. A joint filing
  (a fund with its general partner and manager) counts once.

Insider activity is issuer-level, like the ticker page itself: a company
with several share classes appears once, under the ticker its insiders'
filings use most. Companies with no ticker are left out.

`sort`: activity (number of trades), buys (purchase value), sells (sale
value) or net (purchases minus sales). `q` keeps tickers or company names
that start with it. Paging is by offset (`next_cursor`), because the ranking
keys are aggregates that change as filings arrive.
Markers for the event timeline: insider trades and planned sales, by trade date.

get.description:
Filing dates held for Forms 3/4/5, and the business days inside that range that aren't
fully loaded.

Each day is compared with the SEC's daily index (the official list of the
day's filings): a day counts as loaded when 99% of its filings are held.
Days not yet compared count as loaded when they hold at least 50 Form 4s
(EDGAR receives hundreds every business day). Today is left out until its
index is published in the evening.
Daily closes for one ticker from the stored price history (licensed data: private mode only).

since.title: Since

filings.title: Filings

p50_seconds.title: P50 Seconds

p95_seconds.title: P95 Seconds
p95_seconds.description: 95% of those filings were on the site within this many seconds

target_seconds.title: Target Seconds
target_seconds.description: the live goal: 95% of filings within this many seconds

target_met.title: Target Met
target_met.description: p95_seconds <= target_seconds; null when there's nothing to measure

outages.title: Outages
outages.description: times the worker was down (heartbeat gap over 5 minutes) during filing hours

outage_seconds.title: Outage Seconds
outage_seconds.description: how long those outages lasted within filing hours, in all

filings_during_outages.title: Filings During Outages
filings_during_outages.description: filings accepted while the worker was down, or within the target time (2 minutes) before it stopped, so the live feed never had a fair chance at them; not in the figures

found_later.title: Found Later
found_later.description: filings the live feed missed although the worker was running, found later by the daily index checks or the gap filler; included in the figures with their full wait

days.title: Days
days.description: the same figures for each business day in the window, newest first, so a change to the collector shows from the day it ran

DetectionDelay.title: DetectionDelay
DetectionDelay.description:
How quickly new Form 4s reach the site: from EDGAR accepting a filing to it being loaded here.

Only Forms 4 and 4/A accepted in filing hours count, so the slow off-hours polling
doesn't blur the figure. Filings that were waiting while the worker was down (a gap of
over 5 minutes in its heartbeat, at any hour) are counted separately and left out of the
median and the 95th percentile, and so are filings the live feed missed and a later
check found. `outages` counts only the stops that reach into filing hours, so a filing
can be set apart for a stop that isn't in that count (accepted at 9:59 PM ET, say, with
the worker stopped overnight).

HoldingOut.title: HoldingOut
HoldingOut.description:
One holding listed on a Form 3 (the first statement a new insider files).

For a derivative holding (an option, a restricted stock unit, a warrant), Form 3
gives no count of the derivatives themselves: `shares` is then None and the
size is `underlying_shares`, the number of shares it gives a right to. The
terms (price, dates) are as filed; missing ones are None, never guessed.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: why the latest run failed, as one plain sentence (the full error is in the worker's log)

buys_left_out.title: Buys Left Out
buys_left_out.description: counted buys whose value is left out of buy_value: a figure that can't be right as filed, or a price in another currency

sells_left_out.title: Sells Left Out
sells_left_out.description: the same for sales and sell_value

first_filed.title: First Filed

planned_sales.title: Planned Sales
planned_sales.description: current Form 144 notices this person or organization filed as the seller (a notice replaced by an amendment isn't counted)

issuer.description: the company whose shares the notice is about (given on a seller's profile)

ticker.title: Ticker

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: direct, or the indirect holder text

PriceBarOut.title: PriceBarOut

PriceSeriesOut.title: PriceSeriesOut
PriceSeriesOut.description: Daily closes for one ticker from one provider. Private mode only (PLAN.md decision 1).

sublabel.title: Sublabel
sublabel.description: ticker: the company; person or fund: role and company, e.g. 'Director, Snowflake Inc.'; company: its ticker

buy_value.title: Buy Value
buy_value.description: sum of reported purchase values; null when there are none

sell_value.title: Sell Value
sell_value.description: sum of reported sale values; null when there are none

net_value.title: Net Value
net_value.description: buy_value minus sell_value; null when a side has trades but no reported values

insiders.title: Insiders
insiders.description: distinct insiders the trades are attributed to

trades_without_price.title: Trades Without Price
trades_without_price.description: trades counted above whose filing gives no price, so they have no value and add nothing to the sums (the sums are lower bounds)

trades_left_out.title: Trades Left Out
trades_left_out.description: trades counted above whose price is stated but left out of the dollar sums: another currency, a currency the filing doesn't state, or a figure that can't be right as filed (buys_left_out + sells_left_out)

TickerActivityRow.title: TickerActivityRow
TickerActivityRow.description: One row of the ticker index: a company's open-market insider trading in the window.

since.title: Since
since.description: first trade date in the window (inclusive)

until.title: Until
until.description: last trade date in the window (inclusive), today in US Eastern time

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent
TimelineEvent.description: One marker on the ticker event timeline.

role.title: Role
role.description: role on the largest lot's filing, e.g. 'Director, 10% owner'

value.title: Value
value.description: total dollar value of the lots

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: total shares; null when a lot doesn't give its share count

lots.title: Lots
lots.description: how many trades (lots) the entry adds up

lot_values.title: Lot Values
lot_values.description: each lot's dollar value, largest first

largest_transaction_id.title: Largest Transaction Id
largest_transaction_id.description: the largest lot: the amount opens its quick look

TodayEntry.title: TodayEntry
TodayEntry.description:
One owner's open-market buying (or selling) in one company, disclosed today.

A Form 4 often reports one sale as several lots at different prices, and an
owner may file more than once a day; all of one owner's lots in one company
are one entry, so the strip lists five different people, not one person's lots.

day.title: Day
day.description: the day the figures cover: today (US Eastern) on an SEC business day, otherwise the latest SEC business day before today

edgar_open_today.title: Edgar Open Today
edgar_open_today.description: false on weekends and SEC holidays, when EDGAR accepts no filings (then `day` is the latest business day)

largest_buys.title: Largest Buys
largest_buys.description: up to 5 entries, largest total first

largest_sells.title: Largest Sells
largest_sells.description: up to 5 entries, largest total first

TodaySummary.title: TodaySummary
TodaySummary.description:
The "today" strip on the Live page (US Eastern date).

EDGAR takes no filings on weekends and federal holidays, so on those days the strip
covers the latest SEC business day instead of an empty "today" (see feed.strip_day).

owner.description: the owner that row is filed under

TradeCopy.title: TradeCopy
TradeCopy.description: Another filing's row for the same trade (see smt.ingest.quality.mark_duplicates).

source_note.title: Source Note
source_note.description: set when the row came from the SEC bulk data set (rounded values)

copies.title: Copies
copies.description: other filings' current rows for this same trade that point at this one (duplicate_of), directly or through another copy; totals count the trade once

TradeDetail.title: TradeDetail
TradeDetail.description: Everything the quick-look drawer shows for one trade.

data_issues.title: Data Issues
data_issues.description: values that can't be right as filed: date_after_filing, value_implausible (numbers are shown as filed but left out of rankings and totals); amendment_unpaired (an amended row that couldn't be matched to the row it corrects, so it may repeat it: left out of totals)

in_totals.title: In Totals
in_totals.description: counted in the totals this row sits next to. On a person's trades list that is the person's own totals (smt.api.queries.PERSON_COUNTED); everywhere else the site-wide totals (COUNTED). Only open-market buys and sells are ever counted.

duplicate_of.description: set when another filing reports the same trade (a fund and its general partner, or the same trade filed again): the copy that the totals next to this row count (on a person's trades list, that person's own totals; elsewhere the site-wide totals). The site-wide totals never count this row; `in_totals` says whether the totals next to it do.

TradeRow.description: A transaction as shown in trade tables (person, ticker).
